name: Coolify
description: Coolify is a self-hostable platform-as-a-service for deploying apps, databases, and services on your own hardware. It supports Docker-based deployments, automatic SSL, and a web dashboard, giving you a Heroku or Vercel-like experience without the vendor lock-in. Ideal for developers who want full ownership of their infrastructure.
highlights: Deploy apps, databases, and services with one click
Automatic SSL certificates via Let's Encrypt
curatorNote: Coolify makes self-hosting feel like a managed service. If you have a spare VPS, this is the fastest route from zero to a personal cloud.
